notes.title: Cozy Marbles Demo Update
notes.content:
Today I removed the Cozy Marbles demo, so I quickly wanted to give an update as to why. The demo has been live since June 2024 and since then I’ve made some pretty big changes to the game during development, so it doesn’t quite fully reflect the current state of the game. 

I plan on putting another demo live in the future and hosting playtests as well. Sign-up for the next playtest here via the ‘request access’ button - although I don’t have a date for a playtest yet, when I’m ready to start testing I’ll let you know.

As I work hard on code, art and content for Cozy Marbles, I’d love to hear from you! What are the things you want to see and be able to do in this game? 

Cheers!
~Tim

notes.title: New Demo & Wholesome Games Steam Celebration!
notes.content:
[h3][h1]Cozy Marbles is participating at the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration![/h1][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889456/2b57b3af74b4087568f47ba22d9a644981d7b961.png[/img]

[b]For this special occasion, a brand new demo version just went live![/b]
It features a lot of 'Quality of Life' improvements, plus some more content.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889456/7b49219de574f9912e2e563fc50f847876f9cd51.jpg[/img]
Add small 'decoration' objects to your big marble runs to make races more exciting!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889456/54446bdf052d5b7874d038e1f20d439b1ba1690c.jpg[/img]
Speaking of which, the racing feature is now live in the demo! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889456/e1a68c6e791faaf5ef9444954080c608bbba28f2.jpg[/img]
The new snapping feature (indicated by little white circles) makes building sooo much easier now. just hover your mouse over a snap point, and rotate by clicking the scroll wheel.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889456/78407a24c0890f7785794434ee459318f0a20930.jpg[/img]
Finally you can box select multiple objects now, and move & rotate them after placing. convenient!


As always, i'm super excited to see what you build with the demo!
Have fun,
~Tim from Pixel Pea Games
